title: Enhancing Multimodal RLVR with Pairwise Token Contrast and Adaptive Trajectory Confidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.21671v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning, but group-relative policy optimization broadcasts a single sequence-level advantage to every token of a response, although errors usually localize to a few decisive steps. Recent self-distilled variants refine credit with a teacher--student likelihood gap. However, this signal cannot tell whether it relies on the image or on a language shortcut, and is applied uniformly even when the teacher is uninformative. To address this, we propose Pairwise token contrast and Adaptive trajectory ConfidencE (PACE). Pairwise token contrast scores each response under four teacher views, crossing a correct or incorrect answer hint with the image present or removed, and compares the two hints for every token, which cancels shifts shared by both hints and reveals whether the token's support relies on the image. Adaptive trajectory confidence measures how well the teacher

translated_title: 基于成对Token对比与自适应轨迹置信度的多模态RLVR增强方法
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升多模态推理能力，但组相对策略优化会将单一的序列级优势广播到响应的每一个token上，而实际上错误往往只集中在少数几个关键步骤。近期的自蒸馏变体利用教师-学生似然差来细化信用分配，然而该信号无法区分模型的支撑究竟来自图像还是来自语言捷径，并且即使教师模型缺乏信息量时仍被均匀地应用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了成对Token对比与自适应轨迹置信度方法（PACE）。成对Token对比在四种教师视图下对每个响应进行评分，即将正确或错误的答案提示与图像存在或移除进行交叉组合，并对每个token比较两种提示的得分，从而抵消两种提示共同的偏移，揭示该token的支撑是否依赖于图像。自适应轨迹置信度则衡量教师模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PACE方法，通过在四种教师视图下进行成对Token对比来判别每个token的支撑是否真正依赖图像信息，并结合自适应轨迹置信度按信息量调节教师信号的应用强度，从而在多模态RLVR中实现更精准的细粒度信用分配。
en_tdlr: PACE uses pairwise token contrast across four teacher views to reveal whether each token's support truly relies on the image rather than a language shortcut, and applies adaptive trajectory confidence to weight the teacher signal by its informativeness, enabling finer-grained credit assignment in multimodal RLVR.
